stories.title: Childline warns of summer spike in children seeking body image support
stories.summary: Childline is warning of a likely summer spike in children seeking support for body image concerns. stories.title: North Wales Police stop 40 vehicles in food delivery driver crackdown
stories.summary: North Wales Police stopped around 40 vehicles in a crackdown on food delivery drivers. The operation ran on Friday night as part of the force’s Roads Crime Unit enforcement activity. Nine drivers were reported for having no insurance. Seven vehicles were seized. One driver was reported for driving otherwise than in accordance with a licence.
